name: 左文右圖＋收合清單＋小圖片列
desc: 上段左文右圖，中段是橫跨內容寬度、各自有外框的收合清單，下段一排置中的小圖片。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊，內容對齊頁面內容寬度，由上而下分成三段。上段左右兩欄：左欄約佔一半，大標題（可多行）在上、說明文字在下；右欄靠右放一張方形圖片，約佔內容寬度的四分之一，相對左欄垂直置中。中段和上段之間留較大空白，下方是收合清單：多個項目，每項是一個有外框的標題列，橫跨整個內容寬度，標題靠左、右端放圓形加號小圖示，點擊後在列下方展開說明文字；項目之間各自分開，不用分隔線。下段是一排置中的小圖片，每張明顯小於上段圖片，圓形或方形，完整顯示。區塊下緣有一條橫跨畫面的分隔線。
mobile: 改為直向堆疊：大標題置中在最上方，完整落在畫面寬度內，接著是置中的方形圖片，再來是說明文字、收合清單；收合清單每列維持標題在左、加號在右，橫跨內容寬度。最下方的小圖片不再排成一排，改為錯落排列：相鄰兩張左右錯開、上下錯開，其餘換到下一列。下緣分隔線保留。

en.name: Text and image split + accordion + small image row
en.desc: Top part has text on the left and an image on the right, the middle is an accordion of outlined rows spanning the content width, and the bottom is a centered row of small images.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content, aligned to the page content width and divided into three parts from top to bottom. The top part has two columns: the left column takes about half the width, with a headline (may wrap to multiple lines) above a description; the right column holds a square image aligned right, about a quarter of the content width, vertically centered against the left column. Leave a larger gap between the top part and the middle part, which is an accordion: multiple items, each an outlined title row spanning the full content width, with the title on the left and a small circular plus icon at the right end; clicking a row expands a description below it. The items stand apart from one another, with no dividers. The bottom part is a centered row of small images, each clearly smaller than the image in the top part, circular or square, shown in full. A divider spanning the viewport runs along the bottom edge of the section.
en.mobile: Stack vertically: the headline is centered at the top and stays fully within the screen width, followed by the centered square image, then the description and the accordion; accordion rows keep the title on the left and the plus icon on the right, spanning the content width. The small images at the bottom no longer sit in one row and are staggered instead: neighboring images are offset left and right and up and down, with the rest wrapping to the next row. The bottom divider remains.
